title: Engineering: Structures and Machines
description: Load a beam, find the forces in a truss, size a section and gear a hoist. The statics and strength of materials behind real structures.
audience: An adult comfortable with algebra and basic trigonometry who knows forces, Newton's laws, work and energy, as in Physics: Motion and Forces.

modules.title: Loads and equilibrium
modules.summary: Force components, moments and the reactions of a supported beam.

concepts.title: Forces as vectors
concepts.summary: Resolve forces into components and add them on a free-body diagram.

concepts.summary: Find the moment of a force about a point and balance clockwise against anticlockwise.

concepts.title: Reactions of a supported beam
concepts.summary: Use ΣF = 0 and ΣM = 0 to find the support reactions of a beam.

modules.title: Beams and stiffness
modules.summary: Shear and bending moment, bending stress and deflection.

concepts.title: Deflection and stiffness

modules.title: Machines
modules.summary: Levers, pulleys, gear trains, efficiency and power.

concepts.title: Levers and pulleys
concepts.summary: Trade distance for force with levers and rope systems, and count what it costs.
